repository.name: vllm-project/vllm-ascend
repository.snapshot_note: This knowledge anchors the repository state at the analyzed commit. interface_surface entries list full method signatures so downstream commit-diff analysis can detect signature/behavior changes.

project_overview.what: vLLM Ascend (vllm-ascend) is the hardware plugin that runs the upstream vLLM engine on Huawei Ascend NPUs (910B/A2, A3, A5, and 310P). It is not a fork of vLLM; it integrates through vLLM's pluggable platform interface and a set of monkey-patches.
problems_solved: Provides an NPUPlatform plugin so vLLM selects Ascend device, attention, worker, communicator and compilation backends.
Implements Ascend-native attention backends (FIA/FA3, MLA, SFA, DSA, DCP/PCP) over CANN operators instead of CUDA/Triton/FlashInfer.
Implements ACL Graph (Ascend's equivalent of CUDA Graph) capture/replay and a custom inductor compile backend with FX fusion passes.
Bridges upstream vLLM APIs to torch_npu/CANN when upstream assumes CUDA/ROCm (memory APIs, kv-cache dtype strings, mamba block sizes, structured outputs, etc.) via version/compat patches.

Supports PD disaggregation, KV transfer (Mooncake, AscendStore, UCM, SFA-PD, sparse KV offload), EPLB/MoE load balancing, speculative decoding, quantized MoE (W4A8/W8A8/MXFP), LoRA, sleep/wake and weight switching.
Manages Ascend-specific KV cache geometry (NZ layout, packed C8/SFA indexer caches, hybrid attention+Mamba caches).

core_modules.responsibility: Plugin entry points. register() returns the NPUPlatform path; register_connector/register_model_loader/register_service_profiling/register_model hook extra components; _ensure_global_patch() applies process-wide patches at plugin load. Also stubs old triton APIs (gluon, _aggregate) for compatibility.
core_modules.implementation: vLLM calls register() via the `vllm.platform_plugins` entry point in setup.py and instantiates the returned class. Other register_* functions are invoked through separate entry points (connectors, model_loader, profiling, model registry). Global patches are applied lazily to be spawn-safe.

core_modules.responsibility: NPUPlatform: the central platform abstraction (device type 'npu', dispatch key PrivateUse1). Owns attention backend selection, quantization method list, worker/scheduler setup, KV-cache-spec registration, compile/pass-manager registration, communicator and graph wrapper class selection, and extensive config validation/normalization.
core_modules.implementation: check_and_update_config() is the main pipeline: configure logging, validate parallel/PCP/DCP/indexer/engram/routing configs, auto-detect quantization, fix GPU-incompatible options, init AscendConfig, update compilation modes, setup worker/scheduler, set NPU allocator env. get_attn_backend_cls() dispatches by (use_mla, use_sparse, use_compress) and hardware family (STANDARD vs COMPATIBILITY for 310P). set_additional_forward_context() builds the extra forward context (MoE comm method, MC2 mask, PCP/DP token counts) for MRV2.

core_modules.responsibility: Model runner and worker implementations. worker.py NPUWorker(WorkerBase); model_runner_v1.py NPUModelRunner(GPUModelRunner) = Model Runner V1; v2/model_runner.py NPUModelRunner(GPUModelRunner) = Model Runner V2. The v2 tree adds input_batch, block_table, aclgraph_utils, states, eplb, pcp_manager, pp_transport and per-algorithm spec_decode directories.
core_modules.implementation: NPUWorker overrides device init (DP local-rank shifting, assigned_physical_gpu_ids), memory profiling (per-layer multi-group scaling, sparse offload budget, KVPP budget), execute_model (PP isend/irecv tensor dicts, KV connector passthrough), compile_or_warm_up_model (compile ranges, ACL graph capture, ATB warmup, CPU binding) and sleep/wake via CaMemAllocator. NPUModelRunner overrides input prep, attention metadata build, KV cache allocation/reshape (C8/SFA/MLA packed layouts), graph capture, draft-token proposal and sampling.

core_modules.responsibility: Attention backends and metadata builders: AscendAttentionBackend (GQA/FIA), AscendMLABackend, AscendSFABackend (sparse MLA + indexer), AscendDSABackend (DeepSeek-V4 compressed/sparse attention), AscendFABackend (FA3 RL-consistency), plus DCP/PCP subclasses under context_parallel/ and 310P compatibility variants.
core_modules.implementation: Backends expose get_name/get_impl_cls/get_builder_cls/get_kv_cache_shape/get_supported_kernel_block_sizes/swap_blocks/copy_blocks. get_kv_cache_shape returns NZ-friendly shapes such as (2, num_blocks, num_kv_heads, block_size, head_size) for GQA and (num_blocks, block_size, num_kv_heads, head_size) for MLA. Builders construct AscendMetadata from AscendCommonAttentionMetadata and divide the batch into prefill/decode states (PrefillNoCache/PrefillCacheHit/DecodeOnly/ChunkedPrefill/SpecDecoding).

core_modules.responsibility: ACL graph capture/replay and inductor integration: acl_graph.ACLGraphWrapper (FULL/PIECEWISE), breakable_aclgraph.BreakableACLGraphWrapper, compiler_interface.AscendCompiler, graph_fusion_pass_manager.GraphFusionPassManager, updatable_graph, and passes/ (allgather_chunk_noop, muls_add, noop_elimination, norm_quant_fusion, qknorm_rope_fusion).
core_modules.implementation: ACLGraphWrapper mirrors vLLM's CUDAGraphWrapper API but replays torch.npu.NPUGraph objects; entries are keyed by BatchDescriptor, input addresses are verified in DEBUG, and graph pools come from current_platform.get_global_graph_pool(). piecewise/replay differences from CUDA are handled by re-sourcing cu_seqlens/seqused from persistent device tensors, because Python-side refreshes never re-run after capture.

core_modules.responsibility: Scheduler extensions and KV-cache geometry: batch_job_aware_scheduler, dyntra_lb_scheduler, profiling_chunk_predictor + scheduler_profiling_chunk, recompute_scheduler, short_request_first_scheduler, single_type_kv_cache_manager, kv_cache_interface (Ascend spec classes), kv_cache_placement (KVPP).
core_modules.implementation: Custom Scheduler/AsyncScheduler subclasses are installed by swapping scheduler_cls during config validation. kv_cache_interface defines AscendMLAAttentionSpec, AscendSFAIndexerCacheSpec, AscendSlidingWindowMLASpec, AscendIndexerKPoolTailSpec, AscendCircularBufferSpec and registers them with KVCacheSpecRegistry so the scheduler allocates Ascend-specific page layouts.

core_modules.responsibility: Hardware abstraction and memory: hardware_profile (HardwareProfile/HardwareCapability families per A2/A3/A5/310P), device_config, device_op (BaseDeviceAdaptor + A5/Ascend310P adaptors exposing DeviceOperator), utils. device_allocator.camem (CaMemAllocator) and sleep_mem_optimized (SleepWakeupManager).
core_modules.implementation: HardwareProfile is an immutable frozen dataclass selecting attention backend family, CPU binding mode, worker class, device adaptor family, addressing mode, weight layout policy, MoE comm policy and quantization backend family, plus a frozenset of additive HardwareCapability contracts queried via supports(). CaMemAllocator is a singleton that installs an NPUPluggableAllocator on top of CANN mem, tagging allocations so sleep() can offload or unmap them and wake_up() can remap.

core_modules.responsibility: Parallel groups and communication: parallel_state (init_ascend_model_parallel, MC2/MLP-TP/OTP/LMHead-TP/Embed-TP/replicated/P-TP/dynamic-EPLB/KVPP groups), device_communicators (NPUCommunicator, pyhccl), KV transfer connectors (kv_p2p mooncake/sfa_pd_rd2h, kv_pool ascend_store/ucm/sparse offload), weight_transfer (hccl_engine, npu_ipc_engine), eplb.
core_modules.implementation: NPUCommunicator extends vLLM's DeviceCommunicatorBase and routes collectives through HCCL/ATB; custom op collectives can be enabled (use_custom_op_collectives). KV transfer connectors subclass KVConnectorBase_V1 and register via register_connector().

core_modules.responsibility: Quantization methods and configs: quantization/methods/{w8a8,w4a8,w4a4,wna16,kv_cache}, base.py (AscendLinearScheme/AscendAttentionScheme/AscendMoEScheme), registry.py (register_scheme/get_scheme_class), configs/{modelslim,fp8,compressed_tensors,modelopt_mxfp8}, method_adapters, quant_parser, quant_type.
core_modules.implementation: Schemes are registered per (quant_type, layer_type) and instantiated by linear/MoE layers; adapters translate them into vLLM LinearMethod/quantization config objects.

core_modules.responsibility: Ascend-specific model implementations registered into ModelRegistry: deepseek_v4/v41 (+engram), glm5next, minimax_m3, plus draft/MTP models (deepseek_mtp, kimi_k3*, llama_eagle3*, qwen3_dspark/dflash2, gemma4_mm, glm5_dspark).
core_modules.implementation: models/__init__.py register_model() calls ModelRegistry.register_model for each Ascend architecture (invoked via register_model() plugin entry point). These complement upstream models that are patched rather than reimplemented.

core_modules.responsibility: Speculative decoding proposers: llm_base_proposer (AscendSpecDecodeBaseProposer), eagle, dflash/dflash2, dspark, medusa, ngram, suffix, draft, gemma4, step3p5, multi_kv_cache_group, extract_hidden_states.
core_modules.implementation: AscendSpecDecodeBaseProposer(SpecDecodeBaseProposer) overrides model loading, embedding/lm-head sharing, draft metadata prep, padded-batch runs and ACL graph metadata; specialized proposers derive from it.

core_modules.responsibility: Sampling ops: AscendSampler(Sampler), AscendTopKTopPSampler(TopKTopPSampler), AscendRejectionSampler(RejectionSampler), penalties.
core_modules.implementation: Overrides apply_penalties, top-k/top-p (native vs torch_npu path), and speculative rejection sampling with NPU Triton kernels and pytorch fallbacks.

core_modules.responsibility: Monkey-patches to upstream vLLM. platform/ = applied before worker starts (global patches); worker/ = applied per-worker. patch/__init__.py documents every patch (target, why, how, related PR, future plan).
core_modules.implementation: adapt_patch(is_global_patch=True) is called from NPUPlatform.pre_register_and_update() and _ensure_global_patch(); adapt_patch(is_global_patch=False) from NPUWorker.__init__ and worker-side entry points.

core_modules.responsibility: Self-contained Ascend 310P (compatibility) implementation: worker_310p.NPUWorker310, model_runner_310p.NPUModelRunner310, attention_v1.AscendAttentionBackend310, fused_moe, ops (fla/gdn/qwen3vl), quantization (modelslim W8A8), sample, spec_decode, v2 worker tree.
core_modules.implementation: Selected by HardwareProfile(default_worker_cls=NPUWorker310, AttentionBackendFamily.COMPATIBILITY, QuantizationBackendFamily.COMPATIBILITY). Forces NZ weight layout; uses Ascend-friendly fallbacks (CPU interpolate, non-Triton native pos-embed).

core_modules.responsibility: CANN custom operator kernels exposed to the plugin, plus compilation pass utilities (npugraph_ex_utils_check).
core_modules.implementation: Built by CMake/setup.py into the vllm_ascend_C extension and registered as torch custom ops.

core_modules.responsibility: Operator layer: fused_moe (routers, dispatchers, prepare/finalize, quant, eplb), triton/ (FLA/KDA/mamba/batch-invariant/custom Triton kernels), and top-level ops (linear, layernorm, rotary_embedding, mla, dsa, gdn, kda, causal_conv1d, vocab_parallel_embedding, register_custom_ops).
core_modules.implementation: register_custom_ops registers torch.ops.vllm.* / CANN ops; ops.register_dummy_fusion_op installs placeholder ops for compile-time pattern matching.

core_modules.responsibility: Offloader (prefetch/swap of weights) and warmup (early_kernel_warmup, nz_warmup, rms/indexer/penalties/rejection triton warmups, kernel_warmup).
core_modules.implementation: kernel_warmup(worker) is invoked from NPUWorker.compile_or_warm_up_model() to precompile kernels before serving.

core_modules.responsibility: Non-standard weight loaders: netloader (elastic network load), rfork (seed-server/session/transfer-backend remote fork loader).
core_modules.implementation: Registered via register_model_loader() plugin entry point.

core_modules.responsibility: EPLB core (policies: default/random/flashlb/swift-balancer/stair, eplb_worker, eplb_device_transfer_loader) + vllm adaptor (VllmEplbAdaptor); EC (expert-consistency) manager.
core_modules.implementation: VllmEplbAdaptor bridges Ascend EPLB to upstream MoE layer expert maps; switch weight views are read via quantization scheme get_eplb_weight_views.

implementation_principles.NPUPlatform_registration: vllm_ascend/__init__.py::register() is the `vllm.platform_plugins` entry point (declared in setup.py). vLLM's plugin loader imports it and instantiates the returned NPUPlatform. NPUPlatform.pre_register_and_update() then applies global patches, registers the DeepSeek-V4 vision config convertor, widens argparse choices (--quantization 'ascend', --kv-cache-dtype), and imports quantization configs. NPUPlatform.check_and_update_config() normalizes all config and selects worker/scheduler. register_connector/register_model_loader/register_model/register_service_profiling are separate entry points.
implementation_principles.NPUModelRunner_vs_GPUModelRunner: NPUModelRunner(GPUModelRunner) keeps upstream execute/sample structure but overrides: _prepare_inputs (slot mapping int32, PCP padding, replay start), _build_attention_metadata (Ascend backends/DCP), initialize_kv_cache/initialize_kv_cache_tensors/_allocate_kv_cache_tensors/_reshape_kv_cache_tensors (NZ/MLA/C8/SFA packed layouts), get_kv_cache_spec (Ascend spec classes), initialize_attn_backend, capture_model, _check_and_update_cudagraph_mode, load_model (weight NZ + quantization), propose_draft_token_ids (spec decode). The V2 runner is a fresh implementation over GPUModelRunner with prepare_inputs/execute_model/sample and v2 graph managers.
implementation_principles.ACL_Graph_mechanism: ACL Graph is Ascend's analogue of CUDA Graph. Differences: replay target is torch.npu.NPUGraph; API is graph-npu capture/update rather than cuda graph; graph pools come from current_platform.get_global_graph_pool(); capture/replay splits execution re-sourcing cu_seqlens/seqused from persistent device tensors (query_start_loc_gpu, seq_lens_gpu) because Python-side buffer refreshes do not re-run on replay; NZ and super-kernel/static-kernel paths are Ascend-only; breakable ACL graphs support piecewise replay.
implementation_principles.AscendAttentionBackend_NZ: get_kv_cache_shape returns NZ-friendly layouts. GQA returns (2, num_blocks, num_kv_heads, block_size, head_size) for LBHNC/HND, otherwise (2, num_blocks, block_size, num_kv_heads, head_size). MLA returns (num_blocks, block_size, num_kv_heads, head_size). Supported kernel block size defaults to 128 (MiniMax-M3 fp8 adds MINIMAX_M3_FP8_KV_CACHE_BLOCK_SIZE). AscendMLAAttentionSpec adds scale_dim/scale_dtype/packed C8/turboquant/store_on_host/indexes_kv_by_block_stride.
implementation_principles.Patch_mechanism: adapt_patch(is_global_patch=True) is invoked early (plugin load and NPUPlatform.pre_register_and_update) for platform/ patches affecting scheduler/engine/config. adapt_patch(is_global_patch=False) is invoked inside each NPUWorker.__init__ for worker/ patches affecting runtime. Every patch is documented in vllm_ascend/patch/__init__.py with target, why, how, related PR, future plan.
implementation_principles.EPLB_workload_balancing: EPLB policies (default/random/flashlb/swift-balancer/stair) compute new expert maps from per-rank expert workload; VllmEplbAdaptor reads/writes per-layer expert maps and log2phy maps; quant schemes provide weight views via get_eplb_weight_views; the worker performs an eplb_warmup and the async path commits maps per layer and refreshes Ascend lookup via platform/patch_eplb.py.
implementation_principles.CaMem_allocator: Unlike PyTorch's default allocator, CaMemAllocator installs an NPUPluggableAllocator over CANN mem (my_malloc/my_free) and tags every allocation. sleep(offload_tags) copies tagged allocations to pinned CPU tensors and unmaps/releases device memory; wake_up remaps and copies back. Persistent metadata can use the sleep_persistent tag. This underpins vLLM sleep mode and RL weight-offload scenarios.
implementation_principles.hardware_platform_differences: A2/A3/A5 select STANDARD attention/quantization and the standard worker; A5 enables FP8/DSA/DSV4 packed caches, MegaMoe MXFP, cluster CPU topology and unrestricted MLAPO; 310P selects COMPATIBILITY attention/quantization, the 310P worker, FORCE_NZ weights and ALLGATHER MoE. HardwareProfile + HardwareCapability.supports() is the single gate for these differences.

module_dependencies.entry: setup.py entry points -> vllm_ascend/__init__.py register* -> platform.NPUPlatform -> worker.NPUWorker -> model_runner (v1|v2) -> attention/* + compilation/* + distributed/* + device_allocator/* + quantization/* + ops/* + models/*
notes: platform.py depends on utils, ascend_config, device.hardware_profile, core.kv_cache_interface, quantization.utils, and lazily on vllm config classes.
worker depends on model_runner_v1/v2, distributed.parallel_state, device_allocator.camem, model_executor.warmup, profiler.
attention depends on compilation.updatable_graph, device.device_op, distributed.kv_transfer (ascend_store fence), device.hardware_profile, utils.
core schedulers depend on vllm.v1.core.sched and are installed via scheduler_cls swapping.
quantization/methods/registry provides schemes to ops.fused_moe and ops.linear; models register into vllm ModelRegistry.
patch/* is applied at process boundaries (global vs worker) and mutates upstream vLLM / torch_npu APIs.

inheritable_interfaces.name: vllm.platforms.Platform
inheritable_interfaces.impact_if_changed: Any base signature/semantic change in vLLM's Platform must be mirrored here. get_attn_backend_cls and set_additional_forward_context are the highest-risk: changing attn_selector_config fields or the forward-context dict keys breaks backend selection and MRV2 execution.

inheritable_interfaces.name: vllm.v1.worker.worker_base.WorkerBase
inheritable_interfaces.impact_if_changed: Signature or return-type changes to execute_model/sample_tokens/determine_available_memory break NPUWorker; NPUWorker relies on MemorySnapshot, CompilationTimes and AsyncIntermediateTensors from upstream.

inheritable_interfaces.name: vllm.v1.worker.gpu_model_runner.GPUModelRunner
inheritable_interfaces.impact_if_changed: Overrides depend on upstream private helper names (e.g. _allocate_kv_cache_tensors, _reshape_kv_cache_tensors, _determine_batch_execution_and_padding, _build_attention_metadata). Renames or signature changes here silently break MRV1/MRV2 input preparation, KV allocation and graph dispatch.

inheritable_interfaces.name: vllm.v1.attention.backend.AttentionBackend
inheritable_interfaces.ascend_implementation: AscendAttentionBackend, AscendMLABackend, AscendSFABackend, AscendDSABackend, AscendFABackend, AscendAttentionBackend310
key_methods: get_kv_cache_shape(num_blocks, block_size, num_kv_heads, head_size, cache_dtype_str='') -> tuple[int, ...]
inheritable_interfaces.impact_if_changed: Changes to get_kv_cache_shape semantics or block-size contract alter physical KV cache layout and break all Ascend kernels.

inheritable_interfaces.name: vllm.v1.attention.backend.AttentionMetadataBuilder
inheritable_interfaces.impact_if_changed: AscendCommonAttentionMetadata fields and CommonAttentionMetadata interface are consumed heavily; adding/renaming fields breaks metadata construction.

inheritable_interfaces.name: vllm.v1.attention.backend.AttentionImpl / AttentionLayerBase
key_methods: forward(self, layer, query, key, value, kv_cache, attn_metadata, output=None)
inheritable_interfaces.impact_if_changed: Any change to forward's argument list or attention metadata shape breaks all Ascend attention kernels.

inheritable_interfaces.name: vllm.compilation.cuda_graph.CUDAGraphWrapper
key_methods: __init__(runnable, vllm_config, runtime_mode, cudagraph_options=None, *, use_eagle=False, enable_enpu=False, update_stream=None)
inheritable_interfaces.impact_if_changed: Changes to CUDAGraphOptions, BatchDescriptor, or CUDAGraphMode semantics require matching ACL changes and can break capture/replay dispatch.

inheritable_interfaces.name: vllm.compilation.compiler_interface.CompilerInterface
inheritable_interfaces.impact_if_changed: Inductor integration depends on compute_hash/compile/load contracts; a signature change breaks graph compilation caching.

inheritable_interfaces.name: vllm.v1.sample.sampler.Sampler / TopKTopPSampler / rejection_sampler.RejectionSampler
inheritable_interfaces.impact_if_changed: Speculative sampling correctness depends on these signatures and on the tensor contracts passed to the NPU Triton kernels.

inheritable_interfaces.name: vllm.v1.spec_decode base proposers
inheritable_interfaces.impact_if_changed: Draft-model plumbing and ACL graph metadata for spec decode break if base proposer lifecycle methods change.

inheritable_interfaces.name: vllm.distributed.device_communicators.base_device_communicator.DeviceCommunicatorBase
inheritable_interfaces.impact_if_changed: HCCL collective wiring breaks if base communicator constructor or method signatures change.

inheritable_interfaces.name: vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.base.KVConnectorBase_V1
inheritable_interfaces.ascend_implementation: vllm_ascend/distributed/kv_transfer/* connectors (mooncake, ascend_store, ucm, sfa_pd_rd2h, sparse offload)
inheritable_interfaces.impact_if_changed: PD disaggregation and KV transfer correctness depends on connector base contract and handshake metadata shape.

inheritable_interfaces.name: vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface.KVCacheSpec (+MLAAttentionSpec/SlidingWindowMLASpec/CircularBufferSpec/SlidingWindowSpec)
inheritable_interfaces.impact_if_changed: Field additions/renames in upstream specs invalidate Ascend merge/page-size overrides and can break KV-cache allocation. The code defensively probes optional fields via declared_kwarg.

inheritable_interfaces.name: vllm.config.* config dataclasses (ModelConfig/CacheConfig/ParallelConfig/SpeculativeConfig/AttentionConfig/VllmConfig)
inheritable_interfaces.impact_if_changed: Every config-field rename/add forces a matching patch update; these patches are the most version-sensitive part of the plugin.

not_used_modules_and_paths: Upstream CUDA/ROCm/NVIDIA platform files: vllm/platforms/cuda.py, vllm/platforms/rocm.py, vllm/platforms/tpu.py, vllm/platforms/xpu.py, vllm/platforms/openvino.py, vllm/platforms/cpu.py (only imported indirectly, never implemented here)
flashinfer / FlashAttention CUDA backends and cutlass kernels (vllm.v1.attention.backends.flash_attn*, flashinfer*)
torch.cuda and CUDA graph internals (replaced by torch.npu and ACL graph)
Triton CUDA libdevice paths (patched to CANN equivalent)
vLLM's CUDA-specific quantization kernels (Marlin, GPTQ CUDA, AWQ CUDA, bitsandbytes CUDA)
vllm.v1.worker.gpu.* CUDA graph managers (replaced by Ascend graph managers via worker/patch_v2/patch_*_speculator.py)

patch_catalog.description: Extracted from vllm_ascend/patch/__init__.py. platform patches apply via adapt_patch(is_global_patch=True); worker patches via adapt_patch(is_global_patch=False).

platform_patches.why: Chunked-prefill scheduling mixes prefill/decode in one session, hurting throughput in some scenarios.
platform_patches.how: Enable via --additional-config {'enable_balance_scheduling': true} or VLLM_ASCEND_BALANCE_SCHEDULING=1 (deprecated).
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove when upstream merges the PR.

platform_patches.why: Upstream cannot map DeepSeek-V4 vision checkpoints to the conditional-generation architecture.
platform_patches.how: Register Ascend config conversion; select DeepseekV4ForConditionalGeneration and prefix-LM attention for vision.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove when supported vLLM exposes this natively.

platform_patches.why: Tensor alignment for 310P.
platform_patches.how: Rewrite all_reduce/broadcast.
platform_patches.future_plan: Find a better alignment mechanism.

platform_patches.why: Upstream applies local_dp_rank*world_size offset to a pre-sharded ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES.
platform_patches.how: Tolerate pre-sharded env var instead of applying the offset.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove once upstream handles sharded devices.

platform_patches.why: Uneven attention KV load across DP decode ranks; no upstream extension point.
platform_patches.how: Swap in DyntraLB DP engine core at startup via patch_engine_core.py.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove after stable upstream engine-core plugin interface.

platform_patches.why: Multiple independent run_engine_core wrappers had import-order-dependent correctness.
platform_patches.how: Single wrapper that inits ascend config, re-applies profiling patches, selects DyntraLB/Balance engine core, delegates to pristine upstream.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove once upstream exposes engine-core extension points.

platform_patches.why: Upstream Engram validation requires CUDA.
platform_patches.how: Lift only the CUDA requirement.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove when pin includes the change.

platform_patches.why: Upstream EPLB capability check excludes NPU and lacks an async per-layer commit callback.
platform_patches.how: Expose EPLB capability for NPU; refresh Ascend lookup after async layer commit.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove once EplbPlatformBackend interface lands.

platform_patches.why: Models import FusedMoEFactory directly; must redirect to AscendMoERunner; also preserve DeepSeek-V4 vision routing args (bias_vl, image_sentinel_lo).
platform_patches.how: Patch the factory binding in package __init__ and layer module.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove when upstream exposes backend dispatch for MoE runner.

platform_patches.why: GLM-5.3 always reasons; pinned vLLM lacks PR #56994.
platform_patches.how: Normalize thinking/enable_thinking switches for GLM-5.3 templates.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove once all supported pins include the fix.

platform_patches.why: GLM-5.3-Flash configs are maintained downstream; upstream is_deepseek_mla whitelist omits it.
platform_patches.how: Insert Glm5NextConfig classes into registry; wrap is_deepseek_mla to return True for glm5_next with kv_lora_rank.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove when upstream registers the configs / resolves MLA from contents.

platform_patches.why: PD hybrid Mamba D-side cannot reuse FullAttention-only prefix hits; EAGLE last-block drop zeroes producer hits.
platform_patches.how: Report FA hit length per group; attach kv_transfer_config to KVCacheConfig and skip EAGLE drop on pure producers.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove once upstream exposes PD role to coordinator.

platform_patches.why: Upstream rejects hybrid multi-block + DCP; Ascend supports it for MLA/SWA-MLA.
platform_patches.how: Return lcm(block_sizes)*dcp instead of raising.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove once upstream supports hybrid KV + CP for non-CUDA.

platform_patches.why: PD decode consumer speculative window split too narrow; producer mamba-align page backed off one block.
platform_patches.how: Return full requested width on KV consumers; suppress drop bit on pure producers.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove once upstream preserves speculative atomicity / splits without EAGLE backoff.

platform_patches.why: Upstream block size 16 unsupported on Ascend.
platform_patches.how: Set block size 128 on NPU.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove when vLLM merges support.

platform_patches.why: 310P requires attention page >= mamba page aligned to 128.
platform_patches.how: 310P-specific alignment override selected by hardware profile.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove once upstream supports 310P sizing.

platform_patches.why: Hybrid prefix lookup lacks DCP; get_num_blocks_to_allocate wrong on external hit.
platform_patches.how: Replace with AscendMambaManager; fix block count on external cache hit.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove once upstream supports hybrid DCP lookup and fixes allocation.

platform_patches.why: MiniMax-M2 fp8 validation fails on NPU; HCCL expansion mode tuning; eagle3 whitelist; MiniMax Eagle3 alias.
platform_patches.how: Force quantization=None for MiniMax-M2 fp8; auto-set HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE=AIV; bypass whitelist; register alias.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove once upstream supports MiniMax on NPU.

platform_patches.why: Upstream falls back to FlashAttnPrefillBackend and asserts on Ascend.
platform_patches.how: Register no-op AscendMLAPrefillBackend; Ascend impl handles full forward.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove once upstream exposes a platform hook.

platform_patches.why: daemon=True child processes block EPLB subprocess creation.
platform_patches.how: Set daemon=False.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove when vLLM supports daemon=False.

platform_patches.why: PP+MTP mixed deployment needs spec token metadata on outputs and request-level PP async fences.
platform_patches.how: Add spec_token_ids field; skip stale post_step; add decode fence; build cached data with sync-PP semantics; relax drafter PP validation.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove once upstream carries PP-safe spec metadata.

platform_patches.why: Profiling-based dynamic chunk sizing needs a one-shot profiling pass and per-step latency feedback; spawn subprocesses lose monkey-patches.
platform_patches.how: Replace EngineCore.__init__; wrap update_from_output to feed ProfilingChunkManager; module-level re-application in spawn children.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove when upstream exposes profiling hooks.

platform_patches.why: Many MTP drafts need model_type/architecture remap; DeepSeek-V4 vision DSpark draft arch overwritten; dense drafts inherit expert-parallel flag.
platform_patches.how: Remap MTP architectures and derive n_predict; restore DSparkDraftModel; skip EP check for non-MoE drafts.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove once upstream supports these MTP drafts natively.

platform_patches.why: Mixed backend resolution can crash engine; outlines rejects terminal EOS/stop tokens.
platform_patches.how: Enforce backend consistency; short-circuit outlines accept_tokens after FSM finish.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove once upstream guards mixed backends and outlines terminal case.

platform_patches.why: MRV1 resumes preempted requests via CachedRequestData; without replay_start the worker overwrites shared prefix blocks.
platform_patches.how: Declare and fill replay_start for resumed requests; redeclare msgspec field list.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove once upstream carries replay_start on V1 resume path.

platform_patches.why: torch.accelerator does not route to NPU.
platform_patches.how: Delegate to torch.npu and provide NPU-compatible empty_cache.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove once torch.accelerator routes to NPU.

platform_patches.why: Empty tool_calls serialized for content-only responses; SDKs expect omission.
platform_patches.how: Drop empty tool_calls from model_dump/model_dump_json.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove once supported vLLM includes the PR.

platform_patches.why: Upstream enables v2 by architecture/triton heuristics that crash on Ascend.
platform_patches.how: Return only envs.VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER; worker patch reuses it.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove once Ascend supports all upstream defaulted models.

platform_patches.why: Bundled PyTorch 2.10 requires eps > 0 while upstream passes 0.0.
platform_patches.how: Force eps=1e-5, guarded by ImportError suppression.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove once bundled PyTorch >= 2.13.0.

platform_patches.why: IndexerKVDType Literal rejects 'int8' needed by Ascend sparse attention.
platform_patches.how: Widen Literal to include 'int8' in all three locations and rebuild dataclass schema.
platform_patches.future_plan: Remove once upstream includes 'int8'.

platform_patches.why: Release lane rejected PCP+DP; upstream requires DP>1 for MoE SP but Ascend FlashComm supports DP=1.
platform_patches.how: Drop the release-only validator override (v0.30.0 has #54523); relax use_sequence_parallel_moe to remove DP>1 condition.
platform_patches.future_plan: Re-add/remove based on supported pin; add backend capability hook upstream.

worker_patches.why: Old vLLM builds map fp8 to uint8; Ascend kernels need float8_e4m3fn.
worker_patches.how: Flip dtype to float8_e4m3fn per worker when register_kv_cache_dtype is unavailable.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove once pluggable kv-cache dtype lands on target release.

worker_patches.why: vLLM FULL mode errors.
worker_patches.how: Dynamically replace descriptor creation condition.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove when vLLM merges the PR.

worker_patches.why: GLM-5.2 omits Indexer weights on shared-indexer layers; GLM-5.1 keeps per-layer weights.
worker_patches.how: Skip Indexer construction only when layer skips top-k and is marked shared; MTP keeps full Indexer.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove when pin includes #45895.

worker_patches.why: target_layer_num under PP returns per-stage count, breaking weight prefixes.
worker_patches.how: Use get_total_num_hidden_layers().
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove once upstream uses total layer count.

targets: Eagle3 target inner model forward / make_empty_intermediate_tensors
worker_patches.why: Aux hidden states spanning PP stages cause combine_hidden_states shape mismatch.
worker_patches.how: Propagate aux states through IntermediateTensors across PP stages; merge on last rank.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove once upstream supports cross-stage aux states.

worker_patches.why: Worker re-import would double-wrap the already patched factory.
worker_patches.how: Reuse platform/patch_fused_moe.py idempotently.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove with platform patch once upstream exposes MoE runner dispatch.

worker_patches.why: 310P GDN chunk metadata, spec-decode input shift, GDN state helpers, vision rot_pos_emb race.
worker_patches.how: Route to 310P implementations.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove when upstream exposes stable 310P hooks.

worker_patches.why: interpolate ops unsupported on NPU.
worker_patches.how: CPU interpolate on shape mismatch; get_rope_shape for rope interpolation.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove when vLLM aligns with main.

worker_patches.why: Kernel bugs on Ascend; BLOCK_SIZE 1024 suboptimal; assert breaks KV transfer; state copy ordering.
worker_patches.how: Patch kernel; raise BLOCK_SIZE to 8192; remove assert; per-layer copy metadata.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove once vLLM supports mamba KV transfer dispatch.

worker_patches.why: TP MoE reduce path; fused split-qkv + RMSNorm + rope; fp8 per-block dequant at load.
worker_patches.how: Replace forward and wrap load_weights to dequant fp8->bf16.
worker_patches.future_plan: Move upstream once generic hooks exist.

worker_patches.why: AscendC ops do not support float32 ssm_state.
worker_patches.how: Use triton fused_recurrent_gated_delta_rule.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove when ops support both Qwen3_5 and Qwen3Next.

worker_patches.why: Direct ops.rms_norm/rotary_embedding have no NPU implementation.
worker_patches.how: Replace with vllm-ascend internal implementations.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove when vllm-ascend supports ops.* pattern matching.

worker_patches.why: bind_kv_cache raises on NPU platform.
worker_patches.how: Replace with NPU-compatible version that skips the raise.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove after discussion with vLLM community.

worker_patches.why: PP layer boundaries hidden on inner model; fused split_qkv_rmsnorm_mrope for mrope.
worker_patches.how: Expose properties; override forward with fused kernel.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove when upstream exposes boundaries / pattern matching.

worker_patches.why: Some functions slow/unsupported on NPU.
worker_patches.how: Add npu_top_k_top_p to apply_sampling_constraints; custom triton kernels for expand_batch_to_tokens/rejection_sample.
worker_patches.future_plan: Refactor into AscendRejectionSampler then remove.

worker_patches.why: Upstream does not support Ascend MoE comm types (ALLTOALL, MC2).
worker_patches.how: Override capture to handle tensor_split/all_gather and shape calculation per comm type.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove when upstream abstracts MoE comm type.

worker_patches.why: Step uses Gemmanorm and mixed attention head counts; SP unsupported upstream.
worker_patches.how: Monkey-patch forward for split_qkv_rmsnorm_rope and SP.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove once torch.compile pattern matching and upstream SP refactor complete.

worker_patches.why: Triton ops slow/unsupported on NPU; no dispatch mechanism; next_power_of_2 missing; FLA kda is CUDA Triton.
worker_patches.how: Override with Ascend Triton implementations; inject next_power_of_2; rebind kda entry points.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove when vLLM dispatches triton ops to Ascend backend.

worker_patches.why: V2 worker needs AscendMLAAttentionSpec and AscendSFAIndexerBackend.
worker_patches.how: Rewrite MLA layers to AscendMLAAttentionSpec; route SFA indexer cache to Ascend backend.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove once upstream adds backend hook.

worker_patches.why: Ascend slot mapping must be int32, not int64.
worker_patches.how: Replace with AscendBlockTables.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove when Ascend can use int64 slot mapping.

worker_patches.why: CUDA graph manager unusable on Ascend.
worker_patches.how: Replace with DFlashAclGraphManager.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove once upstream exposes backend-dispatchable spec graph manager.

worker_patches.why: CUDA graph manager unusable for Eagle/MTP on Ascend.
worker_patches.how: Replace with AutoRegressiveAclGraphManager.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove once upstream exposes backend-dispatchable spec graph manager.

worker_patches.why: Upstream dummy-tensor behavior hard to inherit.
worker_patches.how: Replace with AscendInputBatch.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove when make_dummy aligns with vLLM.

worker_patches.why: Ascend prepare_attn differs from upstream.
worker_patches.how: Define AscendModelState and initialize via init_model_state.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove when attention metadata aligns.

worker_patches.why: Target-driven spec decode needs target+draft tokens in same PP slot.
worker_patches.how: Defer broadcast until drafting finishes; carry both in V2 PP queue slot.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove when vLLM transports draft tokens through PP natively.

worker_patches.why: Triton kernels slow/unsupported; CUDA libdevice resolution; compiler limitations on Triton-Ascend.
worker_patches.how: Override with Ascend kernels; rebind libdevice to triton.language.extra.cann.libdevice; reformulate kernels for compiler compatibility.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove when vLLM dispatches and Triton-Ascend lowers these kernels.

worker_patches.why: EngineCore subprocesses only load platform patches.
worker_patches.how: Reuse platform patch.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove with platform patch.

worker_patches.why: Ascend NPU does not support UVA.
worker_patches.how: Make UvaBuffer a dummy class mimicking the interface.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove when NPU supports UVA.

worker_patches.why: Same-checkpoint DSpark drafts get None quant config, breaking W4A8/W8A8 loading.
worker_patches.how: Temporarily redirect get_draft_quant_config to target config.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove once upstream inherits target quant config.

worker_patches.why: torch.compile path unsupported; A5 index_fill_ forces device->host sync.
worker_patches.how: Run allocator eagerly; scoped TorchFunctionMode routes index_fill_ to DeviceOperator (scatter_ on A5).
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove once native A5 operator accepts device indices and compiled allocator is supported.

worker_patches.why: Ascend allocates K/V tuples and Conv/SSM lists; upstream device filtering drops V/SSM; sharded PCP decode needs local counts.
worker_patches.how: Flatten runner cache list before filtering; rebind copy_kv_cache_blocks_inplace to Ascend impl; derive request count from local tokens for PCP decode.
worker_patches.future_plan: Remove when upstream supports multi-tensor allocations and sharded PCP decode.

steps: 在 vllm/model_executor/models/ 下创建模型文件
在 vllm/model_executor/models/registry.py 中注册
在 vllm/config/model.py 中添加架构默认值（如需要）
添加测试：tests/models/
在 vllm/config/ 对应配置类中添加字段（使用 @dataclass + config 元数据）
在 vllm/engine/arg_utils.py 中添加 CLI 参数（映射到配置字段）
添加测试
在 vllm/platforms/ 中创建新的 Platform 子类
通过 vllm.platform_plugins entry point 注册
实现平台特定的 attention、worker、通信等
在 vllm_ascend/patch/platform/ 中创建 patch 文件
实现 monkey-patch 逻辑（修改上游 vLLM 的类/函数）
在 vllm_ascend/patch/__init__.py 中添加文档（what/why/how/related PR/future plan）
Patch 会被 adapt_patch(is_global_patch=True) 自动发现和加载
在 vllm_ascend/patch/worker/ 中创建 patch 文件
实现 monkey-patch 逻辑
在 vllm_ascend/patch/__init__.py 中添加文档（同上）
Patch 会被 adapt_patch(is_global_patch=False) 自动发现和加载
评估是否需要 patch：attention 替换 → worker patch；修改 forward → worker patch；结构差异大 → 在 vllm_ascend/models/ 中创建 NPU 特有实现
添加 worker patch（如 patch_<model_name>.py）
在 vllm_ascend/patch/__init__.py 中记录
添加测试：tests/e2e/models/
在 vllm_ascend/envs.py 的 env_variables 字典中添加
命名遵循 VLLM_ASCEND_* 规范
添加文档注释（默认值、有效范围、是否敏感）
在代码中通过 from vllm_ascend import envs 引用，禁止硬编码环境变量名
在 vllm_ascend/attention/ 中创建新的 attention 实现
继承 vllm_ascend/attention/abstract.py 中的基类
在 vllm_ascend/attention/__init__.py 中注册

vllm.environment_setup: cd ~/code/vllm && source .venv/bin/activate && uv pip install -r requirements/test/cuda.txt

vllm_to_ascend_map.vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connecto: vllm_ascend/distributed/kv_transfer/* (mooncake, ascend_store, ucm, sfa_pd_rd2h, sparse offload)

ascend_only_components: vllm_ascend/compilation/acl_graph.py::ACLGraphWrapper (API-compatible with CUDAGraphWrapper, uses torch.npu.NPUGraph, no vLLM base class)
CaMemAllocator (torch.npu.NPUPluggableAllocator based; only conceptual counterpart vllm/device_allocator/cumem.py)
BaseDeviceAdaptor / DeviceOperator (plugin-local abstraction over torch_npu ops)

init_ascend_model_parallel / destroy_ascend_model_parallel and Ascend-specific process groups (get_mc2_group, get_mlp_tp_group, get_otp_group, get_lmhead_tp_group, get_embed_tp_group, get_replicated_group, get_p_tp_group, get_dynamic_eplb_group, get_kvpp_group)
Ascend-only attention backends/variants: AscendSFABackend, AscendDSABackend, AscendFABackend, AscendAttentionBackend310
Ascend-specific KV transfer connectors (mooncake, ascend_store, ucm, sfa_pd_rd2h, sparse offload)
worker/patch_v2/patch_*_speculator.py (Ascend graph managers replacing vllm.v1.worker.gpu.* CUDA graph managers)

definitely_affected_paths: vllm/platforms/interface.py, vllm/platforms/__init__.py
理由：NPUPlatform 直接继承 Platform 并注册为 OOT 平台；任何方法签名/语义变更（尤其 get_attn_backend_cls 的 attn_selector_config、set_additional_forward_context）必然要求同步修改，且 current_platform 延迟解析契约必须保持。
vllm/v1/worker/worker_base.py, vllm/v1/worker/gpu_worker.py

理由：NPUWorker 继承 WorkerBase/Worker，集中覆写 init_device/_make_model_runner/load_model/determine_available_memory/execute_model/sample_tokens；签名或返回类型（MemorySnapshot、CompilationTimes、AsyncIntermediateTensors）变更必然破坏 NPU。
vllm/v1/worker/gpu_model_runner.py

理由：NPUModelRunner(MRV1/MRV2) 依赖上游私有 helper（_prepare_inputs/_build_attention_metadata/_dummy_run/_allocate_kv_cache_tensors/_reshape_kv_cache_tensors/_determine_batch_execution_and_padding/capture_model）；重命名或签名变更必然破坏输入准备、KV 分配与图调度。
vllm/v1/attention/backend.py
理由：AttentionBackend/AttentionMetadataBuilder/AttentionImpl/MLAAttentionImpl 的位置参数 __init__ 与 forward 严格匹配 Ascend 全部 attention kernel；新增抽象方法或 forward 参数变更必然破坏所有 OOT backend。
vllm/v1/core/sched/interface.py, vllm/v1/core/sched/scheduler.py
理由：AscendScheduler 继承 Scheduler 并覆写调度 hook（schedule/update_from_output/_update_after_schedule/_update_request_with_output）；新增抽象方法必然破坏。
vllm/v1/kv_cache_interface.py, vllm/v1/kv_cache_spec_registry.py
理由：Ascend* KV spec 通过 register_kv_cache_spec 注册并覆写 page_size_bytes/merge/max_memory_usage_bytes/is_uniform_with_collection；新增抽象属性或 page-size 语义变更必然破坏 KV 分配。
vllm/distributed/device_communicators/base_device_communicator.py
理由：NPUCommunicator 继承 DeviceCommunicatorBase；构造函数与方法签名变更必然破坏 HCCL 集合通信与 MoE dispatch/combine。
vllm/distributed/parallel_state.py
理由：init_ascend_model_parallel 及各 Ascend 专用 group 基于上游 group 工厂；GroupCoordinator 构造/接口变更必然影响。
vllm/compilation/compiler_interface.py
理由：AscendCompiler 继承 CompilerInterface；compute_hash/compile/load/initialize_cache 契约变更必然破坏图编译与缓存。
vllm/compilation/cuda_graph.py
理由：ACLGraphWrapper 与 CUDAGraphWrapper API 对齐；CUDAGraphOptions/BatchDescriptor/CUDAGraphMode 语义变更必然要求 ACL 同步。
vllm/model_executor/custom_op.py
理由：Ascend 大量算子通过 register_oot/forward_oot 覆写；__new__ OOT 替换与 dispatch_forward 机制变更必然破坏 NPU kernel 覆盖。
vllm/v1/sample/sampler.py, vllm/v1/sample/ops/topk_topp_sampler.py, vllm/v1/sample/rejection_sampler.py
理由：AscendSampler/AscendTopKTopPSampler/AscendRejectionSampler 依赖这些签名（部分通过 patch）；内部方法重命名会同时破坏子类与 monkey-patch。
vllm/v1/spec_decode/ (SpecDecodeBaseProposer/EagleProposer/MedusaProposer/NgramProposer)
理由：AscendSpecDecodeBaseProposer 覆写 __init__/load_model/dummy_run/_propose/prepare_inputs/set_inputs_first_pass 等生命周期方法，基类变更必然破坏。
vllm/distributed/kv_transfer/kv_connector/v1/base.py
理由：Ascend 各 KV connector 继承 KVConnectorBase_V1；handshake metadata 与 start_load_kv/save_kv_layer 契约变更必然破坏 PD 分离与 KV 传输。
vllm/config/*.py (model.py, cache.py, parallel.py, speculative.py, vllm.py, attention.py)
理由：这些 config 被 vllm-ascend 以 patch 而非子类方式修改；任何字段重命名/新增/移除都会强制 patch 更新，是插件最版本敏感部分。
potentially_affected_paths: 条件：vllm-ascend 不直接子类化，但通过 runner/scheduler 消费；当 step/step_with_batch_queue 的执行顺序、EngineCoreOutputs 结构、collective_rpc 契约变化，或 async-scheduling 的 execute/sample 拆分改变时会影响。
条件：vllm-ascend 不子类化 Executor，仅通过 worker_cls 注入 NPUWorker；当 execute_model/sample_tokens non_block 语义、future 返回类型或 get_class 选择逻辑变化时会影响。
条件：vllm-ascend 通过 register_model 注册 NPU 模型变体；仅当 register_model/resolve_model_cls 签名或 arch 解析语义变化时影响（API 较稳定，一般低风险）。
条件：vllm-ascend 复用上游 manager，仅自定义 single-type manager 通过 registry 注入；当 allocate_slots/get_computed_blocks/BlockPool 分配语义或 watermark 行为变化时影响。
条件：Ascend attention layer patch 间接触发 bind_kv_cache/get_kv_cache_spec；当其契约变化且插件 patch 依赖内部字段时影响。
条件：仅当 Ascend 注册的自定义 logits processor 依赖 validate_params/apply/update_state 契约时影响。
条件：vllm-ascend 默认复用上游 loader；仅当注册自定义 loader 或 LoadConfig 契约变化时影响。
条件：Ascend 用 worker/patch_v2/patch_*_speculator.py 替换这些 manager；仅当被 patch 的内部符号重命名/签名变化时影响。
never_affected_paths: 理由：CUDA 平台实现，Ascend 用 NPUPlatform 取代，从不导入实现。
理由：ROCm 平台实现，与 NPU 无关。
理由：其它加速器/CPU 平台实现，vllm-ascend 仅间接引用，从不实现。
理由：FlashAttention/FlashInfer CUDA 后端与 cutlass kernel，NPU 用 CANN/自研算子替代。
CUDA quantization kernels (Marlin, GPTQ CUDA, AWQ CUDA, bitsandbytes CUDA)
理由：CUDA 专用量化 kernel，Ascend 走 torch_npu 量化路径。
